Current requirements 8.1.5 and 8.1.6
| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **8.1.5** | Verify that regular backups of important data are performed and that test restoration of data is performed. | | | ✓ | 19 |
| **8.1.6** | Verify that backups are stored securely to prevent data from being stolen or corrupted. | | | ✓ | 19 |

Application does not produce backups, it's done by external services - from that perspective it's out of application scope.

And is it realistic to verify 8.1.6?

comments.body: I think it makes sense as a level 3 requirement, security requires availability
I suggest dropping this. It’s more infrastructure.

8.1.6 does not have any relation with application.

With 8.1.5 we can have discussion - is any part of application is involved in this process?

(I don't argue that backups are not important, those are just not part of application responsibility area - it's application security verification standard)

I can keep them in as well - but then I need some clear argumentation and definition, why those are in and some other are not.

Those are in because the availability of the application's data is critical to the security of the application. Arguably anti-automation is an infrastructure level concern or likely to at least be enforced at the infrastructure level but we still include it in the ASVS.
I'm with Elar here, I don't think this should be in here. Different teams deal with such things, and I don't feel this is appsec

Ok so to confirm, are we proposing to delete:
1) Just 8.1.6?
2) Both 8.1.6 and 8.15?

Current requirements 8.1.5 and 8.1.6
| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **8.1.5** | Verify that regular backups of important data are performed and that test restoration of data is performed. | | | ✓ | 19 |
| **8.1.6** | Verify that backups are stored securely to prevent data from being stolen or corrupted. | | | ✓ | 19 |

TLDR: both.

Application does not produce backups, does not restore from backups, does not send backups to external system - an application is not involved in any part or step in backup process.

If we don't put it somehow to clearly understandable application scope, I can not sell to myself, why we should keep those requirements in ASVS.
Created #1488 and would request @jmanico or @danielcuthbert to review.

title: proposal: remove 8.1.5 (regular backups) and 8.1.6 (backup security) as out of scope
